scope: real Google Chrome browser benchmark on macOS; low-load user-visible rendering/XHR diagnostic

versions.mysql: mysql from 12.3.2-MariaDB, client 15.2 for osx10.21 (arm64) using  EditLine wrapper

notes: Chrome and the WordPress server both ran on this Mac, so browser CPU and server CPU are not isolated.
The run measures low-load user-visible latency and XHR behavior, not throughput under high concurrency.
Admin login is prepared before measured admin flows; the measured admin flows start from an authenticated browser session.
No full-page cache, CDN, or object cache was enabled by this runner.
